CH.email: Switzerland: email only if it is individual and relevant, to the company’s general address (info@…), with your identity and a simple way to opt out. Never in bulk (UCA art. 3 para. 1 let. o).
CH.telephone: Switzerland: no calls to numbers marked with an asterisk in the directory (UCA art. 3 para. 1 let. u); call from a displayed number registered in your name (let. v).
CH.linkedin: LinkedIn: message written and sent by hand, personalised. No automation (banned by LinkedIn).

DE.email: Germany: advertising email is banned without prior express consent, even between businesses (UWG § 7 para. 2 no. 2). Only to reply to someone who asked for it.
DE.telephone: Germany: advertising calls only with at least presumed consent (UWG § 7 para. 2 no. 1), meaning a concrete interest on the company’s side. If in doubt, write a letter.
DE.linkedin: Germany: an advertising message on LinkedIn is treated as an email (OLG Hamm, 18 U 154/22). A plain invitation, no sales pitch; only mention Godet if the person asks.

AT.email: Austria: advertising email is banned without prior consent, even between businesses (TKG 2021 § 174 para. 3).
AT.telephone: Austria: advertising calls are banned without prior consent, even between businesses (TKG 2021 § 174 para. 1).
AT.linkedin: Austria: a plain LinkedIn message with no advertising; only mention Godet if the person asks.

IT.email: Italy: promotional email is banned without prior consent, even to a business address found online (Privacy Code art. 130; Garante guidelines of 4 July 2013).
IT.telephone: Italy: call only after checking the Registro pubblico delle opposizioni (paid access); otherwise consent is required.
IT.linkedin: Italy: a promotional private message requires consent (Garante 2013, “social spam”). A plain invitation; Godet only on request.
IT.lettre: Italy: address taken from the business register or the company’s website. If it comes from a telephone directory, check the Registro pubblico delle opposizioni first.

FR.email: France: email is allowed if it relates to the recipient’s trade, with your identity, the origin of the contact details and an unsubscribe link (CNIL). Modest volumes and personalised messages.
FR.telephone: France: calls are allowed if they relate to the recipient’s trade; introduce yourself and respect any refusal (CNIL).

visits.title: Demo visits
visits.lead: Every link sent carries a tracking code (?ref=…). A demo visit with this code is recorded here, without any data about the person.
visits.emptyHint: Visits appear when a prospect opens a demo link with their code.
visits.note: The same visit is only counted once per minute and per code. A visit does not tell you who opened the link: it is a signal, not proof of interest.

letterPage.windowRight: A4 format, address on the right for a C5/6 or DL envelope with a right-hand window. Fold in three at the marks.
